title: RepoAssure Multi-Repo Workspace Repair Summary Planning v0.1
objective: Using the implemented local workspace manifest and existing per-repository repair artifacts, define the local-only multi-repo workspace repair summary as an implementation-ready product and artifact contract without changing production code, executing commands, applying patches, or writing target repositories.
acceptance: Reconcile the current workspace manifest and per-repository repair artifact contracts before proposing a cross-repository summary.

Define workspace-summary inputs, JSON and Markdown artifact boundaries, AI IDE read order, cross-repo prioritization, stale or missing repo handling, repo identity collision policy, redaction, maintainer review, and no-write evidence.
Separate local workspace summary capability from Team Cloud history, collaboration, hosted dashboard, and commercial availability claims.
Produce an implementation-ready planning record and bounded test matrix without changing production code.
Select at most one next implementation or validation Goal after the planning contract is accepted.
